followup_reviews.Research finding: The Dongxing customs-processing suspension and resumption are supported; retain the included goods episode. Bac Luan I, Bac Luan II and Km 3+4 are named. The reported traffic is goods/trucks and both-way processing, not unrestricted passenger admission or all Guangxi gates. Retain 21 December 2021–10 January 2022, 20 calendar days. Later same-day customs figures describe actual cleared trucks, supporting an operational endpoint; precise first-pass clocks and universal permeability remain unknown. Human disease control is expressly attributed to strengthening COVID prevention. Goods priorities do not by themselves establish a protectionist rationale. VNA’s ministry account and customs follow-up were directly read, as was the province’s attributed republication. They are one news lineage with distinct official details, not independent reporting confirmations. A historical Vietnamese page did not yield relevant text and supports no new finding. All current phase bindings remain unlocated. Three named sites do not authorize guessed point coordinates or transfer another Guangxi gate’s reopening date.
